query: After encountering a series of unpleasant interactions that left me feeling both uncomfortable and unsafe, I ultimately made the decision to delete all my online dating profiles. Instead of fulfilling promises of connection, these experiences instilled a sense of wariness and insecurity that I found increasingly difficult to shake off. Thus, I took what I felt was the only reasonable step to protect my emotional well-being and regain a sense of control over my dating life.
